# Vapi: The Voice AI Platform for Developers

> Vapi is the leading voice AI platform that enables developers to build, test, and deploy advanced voice AI agents in minutes. With 4000+ API configurations, 100+ language support, and enterprise-grade scalability, Vapi powers voice AI solutions for everything from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Vapi provides complete control over your voice AI stack with bring-your-own models, comprehensive testing tools, and the most configurable API in the industry, while offering enterprise-grade hosting, multilingual support, and advanced collaboration features.

### Core platform features and benefits:
- Voice AI agent creation and management with 4000+ API configurations
- Real-time voice processing with sub-500ms response times
- Multilingual support for 100+ languages with native voice models
- Bring-your-own models for transcription, LLM, and text-to-speech
- Automated testing suite with hallucination detection
- Tool calling and API integration capabilities
- A/B testing and optimization tools for continuous improvement
- Enterprise-grade security, compliance, and scalability
- Comprehensive developer tools including CLI and SDKs
- Pre-built voice agents and templates to get started quickly

- [Automated Testing](https://docs.vapi.ai/test/test-suites): Design test suites to identify hallucination risks before production
- [Performance Monitoring](https://dashboard.vapi.ai): Real-time analytics and performance insights

### Extend
- [Integrations](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/voice/vapi-voices): Connect to third-party tools and services

- **Most Configurable**: 4000+ API settings vs basic configuration options
- **Fastest Deployment**: Minutes vs months of development time
- **Enterprise Ready**: Used by Fortune 500 companies with proven scalability
- **Bring Your Own Models**: Complete control over AI models vs vendor lock-in
- **Comprehensive Testing**: Built-in hallucination detection vs manual testing
- **Multilingual First**: 100+ languages vs limited language support
- **API-Native**: Everything exposed as API vs limited integration options

## Performance & Scale

- **Latency**: Sub-500ms response time for real-time conversations
- **Uptime**: 99.9% SLA with enterprise-grade reliability
- **Scale**: Handles millions of calls
- **Languages**: 100+ supported languages with native voice models
- **Models**: Integration with all major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)
- **Global**: Deployed across multiple regions for low-latency worldwide

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does Vapi cost?**
A: Vapi offers simple, usage-based pricing starting with a free tier. Check our [pricing page](https://vapi.ai/pricing) for detailed plans and usage calculator.

**Q: Can I test voice agents before deploying?**
A: Yes, Vapi includes comprehensive testing tools and simulators to test your agents before going live. Access these through our [dashboard](https://dashboard.vapi.ai) or [CLI tools](https://vapi.ai/cli).

**Q: Does Vapi support webhooks?**
A: Yes, Vapi provides webhook support for real-time event notifications and data synchronization.

**Q: Can I customize the voice and personality?**
A: Absolutely. Vapi offers multiple voice options and allows complete customization of agent personality and behavior.

**Q: Is there a CLI tool for development?**
A: Yes, Vapi provides a comprehensive [CLI tool](https://vapi.ai/cli) for development, testing, and deployment automation.

**Q: What kind of support is available?**
A: Vapi offers comprehensive documentation, community support, and enterprise support options through our [support page](https://vapi.ai/support).
